name: mycar-plus
description: MyCar+ para Web/PWA e Android com Capacitor
author: Marcelo Batista Ribeiro

scripts.sync:android: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.clean: if exist android\app\build rmdir /s /q android\app\build & if exist android\.gradle rmdir /s /q android\.gradle
scripts.apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
